onboarding.b1: You read hundreds of pages and keep a few lines. Hassad keeps those lines and brings them back when you need them.
onboarding.t2: Harvest an idea the moment it shines.
onboarding.b2: Note it with its page and its book in seconds, so nothing you found is lost.
onboarding.b3: Arrange your books on shelves and choose your most precious notes; Hassad returns one of them to you each day.
onboarding.t4: And your library becomes your harvest.
onboarding.b4: Everything you read and chose, in one place that is yours alone.
onboarding.noteTitle: What you see is all there is
onboarding.noteBody: We build coherent stories from the evidence at hand, and rarely ask what is missing.
